text: Mary saves her digital images on her computer in three separate folders named ‘Family’, ‘Holiday’
and ‘Friends’. Her family folder contains 3 images, her holiday folder contains 4 images and her
friends folder contains 8 images. All the images are different.
Human blood groups are identified by two parts. The first part is A, B, AB or O and the second part
(the Rhesus part) is + or −. In the UK, 35% of the population are group A+, 8% are B+, 3% are AB+,
37% are O+, 7% are A−, 2% are B−, 1% are AB− and 7% are O−.
